name: Atlassian - Software Delivery Performance
description: The Atlassian - Software Delivery Performance dashboard provides insights into the four key metrics used to measure the effectiveness of software development and delivery, in accordance with DevOps Research and Assessment (DORA). The panels display analytics for lead time to changes, time to restore service, deployment frequency, and change failure rate.
title: Atlassian - Software Delivery Performance

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/bitbucket 
//BB Commit Event
| join
 (json "push.changes[0].created",  "push.changes[0].commits[0].date",  "push.changes[0].commits[0].hash"  as  created, bitbucket_commits_date, bitbucket_commit | where %"x-event-key" = "repo:push" ) as bb_commit,

( json field=_raw "buildNumber", "deploymentEnvironment", "branch", "repoFullName", "pipe_result_link", "deploy_status", "pr_id", "commit", "tag", "projectKey", "repoOwner", "commit_link", "event_date" as buildNumber,deploymentEnvironment, deploy_branch, repo_name, pipe_result_link, deploy_status, pr_id, deploy_commit, tag, projectKey, repoOwner,  commit_link, deployevent_date ) as deploy_event
on bb_commit.bitbucket_commit = deploy_event.deploy_commit
| parse regex field= bb_commit_bitbucket_commits_date "(?<commits_date>\d\d\d\d-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d)"  nodrop   
| parseDate(commits_date, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss") as commit_date_milliseconds

| where deploy_event_deploymentEnvironment="production" and deploy_event_deploy_status="0"
| parse regex field=deploy_event_deployevent_date "(?<d>[\S]+) (?<t>[\S]+)"
| concat(d,"T",t) as event_date
| parseDate(event_date, "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss") as deploy_date_milliseconds
| deploy_date_milliseconds - commit_date_milliseconds as lead_time
| lead_time/3600000 as lead_time_in_hrs
| avg (lead_time_in_hrs) as avg_lead_time_in_hrs

on bb_commit.bitbucket_commit = deploy_event.deploy_commit
| parse regex field= bb_commit_bitbucket_commits_date "(?<commits_date>\d\d\d\d-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d)"  nodrop

panels.title: Daily Avg. Time to Restore Service Trends

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts Close p1
| json "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, source, tags, recipients nodrop
| where action = "Close" and priority="p1"
| created_at*1000000 as created_at
| updated_at - created_at as time_to_restore_service
| time_to_restore_service/3600000000 as time_to_restore_service
| timeslice 1d
| avg (time_to_restore_service) as avg_time_to_restore_service by _timeslice

_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts Close p1
| json "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, source, tags, recipients nodrop

| created_at*1000000 as created_at

_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts OR (_sourceCategory = Labs/bitbucket production  deploymentEnvironment pipe_result_link deploy_status commit_link)
| json "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, source, tags, recipients nodrop // alerts
| json field=_raw "buildNumber", "deploymentEnvironment", "branch", "repoFullName", "pipe_result_link", "deploy_status", "pr_id", "commit", "tag", "projectKey", "repoOwner", "commit_link", "event_date"  nodrop  // deploys
| if(!isNull(action) and action !="", "opsgenie", "bitbucket") as type 
| where (type="opsgenie" and action = "Close" and priority="p1") or (type="bitbucket" and deploymentEnvironment="production" and deploy_status="0")
| if(type="opsgenie", 1, 0) as p1_incidents
| if(type="bitbucket", 1, 0) as deploys
| sum(p1_incidents) as incidents, sum(deploys) as deploys 
| (incidents*100/(deploys)) as pct_change_failure_rate
| fields pct_change_failure_rate

_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts OR (_sourceCategory = Labs/bitbucket production  deploymentEnvironment pipe_result_link deploy_status commit_link)
| json "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, source, tags, recipients nodrop // alerts
| json field=_raw "buildNumber", "deploymentEnvironment", "branch", "repoFullName", "pipe_result_link", "deploy_status", "pr_id", "commit", "tag", "projectKey", "repoOwner", "commit_link", "event_date"  nodrop  // deploys
| if(!isNull(action) and action !="", "opsgenie", "bitbucket") as type 
| where (type="opsgenie" and action = "Close" and priority="p1") or (type="bitbucket" and deploymentEnvironment="production" and deploy_status="0")
| if(type="opsgenie", 1, 0) as p1_incidents
| if(type="bitbucket", 1, 0) as deploys
| timeslice 1d
| sum(p1_incidents) as incidents, sum(deploys) as deploys by _timeslice
| (incidents*100/deploys) as pct_change_failure_rate
| fields _timeslice, pct_change_failure_rate

_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts Close p1
| json "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, source, tags, recipients nodrop
| where action = "Close" and priority="p1"
| created_at*1000000 as created_at
| updated_at - created_at as time_to_restore_service
| time_to_restore_service/3600000000 as time_to_restore_service
| avg (time_to_restore_service) as avg_time_to_restore_service

_sourceCategory = Labs/Opsgenie_alerts Close p1
| json "alert.alertId", "alert.createdAt", "alert.updatedAt", "alert.description", "alert.message", "action", "alert.team",  "alert.priority", "alert.source" , "alert.tags[*]","alert.recipients[*]" as alertId, created_at, updated_at, description, message, action, team, priority, service, tags, recipients nodrop
| where priority="p1"
| count_distinct(alertId) as incidents by service
| sort by incidents  
| limit 5

panels.title: Explanation of DORA Metrics
panels.text:
The Accelerate State of DevOps 2019 Report from DevOps Research and Assessment (DORA) highlights four key metrics to measure the effectiveness of software development and delivery. 

The report is available: 
https://cloud.google.com/devops

The four key metrics are: 

1. Lead time to changes: How long does it take to go from code committed to code successfully running in production? This is identified by Bitbucket commits to production events. 

2. Time to restore service: How long does it generally take to restore service when a service incident or a defect that impacts users occurs? This is calculated by the the time it takes to close an Opsgenie P1 incident once opened. 

3. Deployment Frequency: How
often does your organization deploy code to production
or release it to end users?
This is identified via Bitbucket deploy events to production.

4. Change failure rate: What percentage of changes to production or released to users result in degraded
service? This is the percentage of the number of P1 Opsgenie incidents to the number of successful deploys to production.
